title: Junior Web Developer
description: This is a remote position with the ability to work from home. The candidate will be responsible for implementing content updates and style changes using WordPress editor and basic coding. They will also assist in website testing, troubleshooting bugs, and collaborating with other team members to ensure websites are functional and visually appealing. The candidate should have experience working on web development projects and a strong understanding of front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery. Experience with the WordPress CMS is preferred but not required. The candidate will be expected to work independently and take initiative in resolving issues. This is a remote position available to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.
